paite: Huchih lai in Baptispa Johan in,
heading: Baptispa Johan Thugen / (Mar 1.1-8; Luk 3.1-18; Joh 1.19-28)
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

paite: "Kisik un! Van-gam anaita," chi in Judia gamdai ah thu gen in ahong pai hi.
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

paite: Amah ahi, zawlnei Isai in: "Gamdai a mi kikou aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite tangsak un, achi," chi a ana gen pen.
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

paite: Johan in sangawngsau mul puan asilh a, savun kawnggak agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

paite: Huchih lai in Jerusalem khua, Judia gam tengteng, Jordan luidung kim tengteng akiang ah ahong paikhawm ua,
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

paite: akhelhna uh thupha tawi in, Jordan lui ah baptisma atang uhi.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

paite: Himahleh Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tampi ama a baptisma tang ding a hong paite amuh in, akiang uah, "Nou gul suante! Thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon thuhilh ahia?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

paite: Huchi in kisikna toh kilawm gah hon suangkhia un.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

paite: Abraham ka pu uh ahi, chi in kingaihtuah kei un, Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei ka hon chi ahi.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

paite: Tu a kipan in singbul teng ah heipi akoihta uh; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhpeuh aphuk ua, mei ah apailut zel uhi.
english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

paite: Ke'n zaw kisikna ding in tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh, amah ka nung a hong pai kei sang in athupizaw a, akhedap tawitak leng ka hi kei, ama'n zaw Kha Siangthou leh mei in noute ahon baptis ding hi.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

paite: Akhut in phazah atawi a, aphual azapsiang sipsip ding a, buhpang ah abuh asung ding, asi bel mei mit thei lou in ahalmang ding,” achi hi.
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

paite: Huchih lai in akiang a baptisma tang ding in Galili gam a kipan Jordan lui ah Johan kiang ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
heading: Jesu Baptisna / (Mar 1.9-11; Luk 3.21-22)
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

paite: Johan in, "Nang kei na hon baptis kiphamohzaw hinapi, ka kiang ah na hong zosop ahi maw?" chi in akham hi.
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tu in lemsa teitei in, hichibang a diktatna tengteng hihtangtun ei a ding in akilawm ngal a," chi in adawng a, huchi in lem asata hi.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

paite: Huan Jesu baptisma atantak in tui a kipan apawt pah a, ngai in, amah a ding in van ahong kihong a, Pathian Kha, vakhu bang a hong suk in, atung a hong tu amu hi.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

paite: Huan ngai in, van a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," achi hi.
english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
